ObjectName.value: LRT1 2G interior seats removed

Categories.value: LRTA Class 1100|Self-published work|Train interiors of LRT Line 1

ImageDescription.value:
Some seats are taken off LRVs in Line 1 in order to maximize the capacity of each vehicle. This is from Car 1110.

This is because standing passengers would occupy lesser area than those who are seated.

At the center along the removed seats, the wheelchair allocation is visible.

Note the yellow markings on the floor. In line with the COVID–19 pandemic and guidelines for the eased quarantine, physical distancing must be maintained to minimize droplet exposure through visual cues.
